title: Figure 15 (20660): aeronautical chart showing Breckenridge between flight routes
description: Google Earth image of an aeronautical sectional chart around Breckenridge, Texas, showing Stephens Co airport, the Breckenridge RCO circle, Victor airways, Caddo and Wayland. Caption: "Figure 15 (20660) Breckenridge is between to flight routes." Above is the continuation of a witness account describing a silent object with pulsing amber lights at an estimated 10,000 feet.
